description: Captured from `node extension/server.mjs` on a temp DB (LLMIDE_DB_PATH in TMPDIR, LLMIDE_ENGINE_PREWARM=0), replayed over HTTP. No model call and no external network. Not a live HTTP exchange: updateSdk() called in-process with one chat turn "running", which refuses before any npm install or registry access. The route sends this return value verbatim.

response.log: 1 chat turn is running — let it finish (or stop it), then update.
